1496-1981-2415-4050.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1496-1981-2415-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Verdant Sun's Avatar triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.

719-3413-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies as a Human due to Xenograft, Xathrid Necromancer triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

862-1778-2928-6516.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
One of the {0}-cost creatures must be in your hand, with the other being on the battlefield.
862-1778-2928-6516.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.
Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

2921-4120-4186-7352.notablePrerequisites: Vigor has indestructible, protection from creatures or protection from red.
2921-4120-4186-7352.description:
Cast Electric Seaweed by paying {2}{R}{R}.
When Electric Seaweed enters, it triggers.
Activate Electric Seaweed by tapping it, attempting to deal 1 damage to Scurry Oak, which will instead put a +1/+1 counter on it due to Vigor.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Electric Seaweed triggers, dealing 1 damage to each non-Wall creature your opponents control. Each non-Wall creature you control (excluding Vigor) will not be dealt damage, and will instead have a +1/+1 counter put on it due to Vigor.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat from step 5.

489-2034-4013-5004-6643.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Cathodion, adding {C}{C}.
When Cathodion dies, it triggers, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Edgar.
Cast Cathodion from your graveyard by paying {2}.
Repeat.

3373-7276.manaNeeded: {W}{B} plus commander tax if applicable if Dark Leo & Shredder isn't on the battlefield
3373-7276.easyPrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block Dark Leo & Shredder if it's on the battlefield, or another creature you control otherwise.
Dark Leo & Shredder doesn't have summoning sickness if it's on the battlefield.
You control at least four Ninjas.
3373-7276.description:
Declare Dark Leo & Shredder as an attacker if it's on the battlefield, or another creature you control otherwise.
If Dark Leo & Shredder isn't on the battlefield, when the declared creature is unblocked, cast Dark Leo & Shredder either from your hand or from the command zone for its sneak cost by paying {W}{B} plus commander tax if applicable and returning the unblocked attacker to your hand.
Deal combat damage using Dark Leo & Shredder, triggering its second ability, creating a 1/1 Ninja creature token and causing the opponent to lose half their life total, rounded up.
At the beginning of your end step, Astarion triggers, causing the opponent to lose the rest of their life total.
3373-7276.notes: You must control four Ninjas when Dark Leo & Shredder deals combat damage. Notably, if it isn't on the battlefield, you must control five total Ninjas if the attacker you will be returning is a Ninja.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-5078-6556.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Activate Harnfel by discarding a card, exiling the top two cards of your library and allowing you to cast them this turn.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from exile by paying {0}.
Repeat.

3967-6529-7084.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Curse of the Restless Dead triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

1329-1414-4222.description:
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Lotus Petal from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Lotus Petal by paying {0}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Emry.
Repeat.

2781-4590-7042.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two creatures that can attack this turn.
2781-4590-7042.description:
Declare two creatures as attackers, ensuring to attack two different opponents. Commander Liara Portyr triggers, causing spells you cast from exile this turn to cost {2} less to cast.
Cast Appa by paying its mana cost.
When Appa enters, it triggers, exiling Felidar Guardian with the ability to cast it from exile later.
Cast Felidar Guardian from exile by paying {0} due to Commander Liara Portyr.
When Felidar Guardian enters, it triggers, blinking Appa
Repeat from step 3.

1652-5626-6747.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one artifact.
You have at least {E}{E}{E}.
You have a creature card with mana value 3 or less in your graveyard.
1652-5626-6747.description:
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying at most {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing Patron of the Arts and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand.
When Patron of the Arts dies, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Chthonian Nightmare ability, returning another creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing another creature and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Patron of the Arts from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Patron of the Arts enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

2060-2292-2946-6701.easyPrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2060-2292-2946-6701.description:
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript is sacrificed, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters equal to Szarel's power on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Crystalline Crawler twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.
2060-2292-2946-6701.notes: This combo can put infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel so long as its power is greater than the mana needed to activate the creature's ability from your graveyard.

2034-3188-3490-6283.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to gain life.
You have a nonland card on top of your library.
2034-3188-3490-6283.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Social Climber indestructible.
2034-3188-3490-6283.description:
Gain life.
Amalia triggers, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Social Climber triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Amalia triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Amalia trigger, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Repeat from step 3.

4029-4120-4968.easyPrerequisites: Deathbringer Thoctar has a +1/+1 counter on it.
4029-4120-4968.description:
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter on it, targeting itself, but putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Vigor.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter on it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
4029-4120-4968.notes: You may also target your other creatures in step 2 to put +1/+1 counters on them due to Vigor.

uses.n: Optimus Prime, Hero // Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader

5263-5330-6243.description:
Activate Atog by sacrificing Optimus Prime, Hero.
When Optimus Prime, Hero dies, its second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader.
Activate Atog by sacrificing Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader.
When Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader dies, Valkyrie's Call triggers, returning Optimus Prime from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Hero as an Angel with flying.
Resolve both Atog abilities from steps 1 and 3.
Repeat.

222-527-1849-5231.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {B}{G}{G}.
Activate Thermopod twice by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala, adding {R}{R}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

654-880-3585.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
654-880-3585.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Greensleeves and Amulet of Vigor trigger.
Resolve the Greensleeves trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping the land.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-3705-5231-5997.description:
Cast Squee from your graveyard or from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Iraxxa triggers, creating three 2/2 Alien Warrior creature tokens.
Activate Thermopod's second ability three times by sacrificing Squee and two Alien Warriors, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

1393-4050-4986-5034.manaNeeded: {1} if the permanent requires three or more mana to cast
1393-4050-4986-5034.notablePrerequisites: You have a historic permanent card in hand that can be cast using {C} and two colored mana.
1393-4050-4986-5034.description:
Activate Sol Ring by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Aether Channeler, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the historic permanent from your hand by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Aether Channeler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Aether Channeler enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Sol Ring from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Aether Channeler, adding one mana of any color.
Cast Sol Ring by paying {1}.
Teshar triggers, returning Aether Channeler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Aether Channeler enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning the historic permanent cast in step 3 from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Aether Channeler, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 3.
1393-4050-4986-5034.notes: If the historic permanent can be cast for less than {C} and two colored mana, this combo nets infinite mana.

1651-3715-5365-5491.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one counter on a permanent you control.
1651-3715-5365-5491.description:
Activate Power Conduit by tapping it and removing a counter from a permanent you control, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lonis.
Lonis' second ability triggers, creating a Clue and a Map artifact token
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Clue and Map, untapping Power Conduit.
Repeat.

250-3946-4426.description:
Play Glacial Chasm either from your hand or from your graveyard.
When Glacial Chasm enters the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice another land you control.
Play any land from your graveyard.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Glacial Chasm's cumulative upkeep ability and The Gitrog Monster's first ability trigger.
Resolve The Gitrog Monster trigger, sacrificing Glacial Chasm.
Resolve the Glacial Chasm trigger, choosing not to pay and doing nothing as Glacial Chasm is no longer on the battlefield.
Repeat.

85-1006-2178.notablePrerequisites:
All Equipments and/or Auras attached to the same creature.
That creature does not have summoning sickness.
85-1006-2178.description:
Activate the creature by tapping it, dealing damage to an opponent's creature.
The opponent's creature dies due to deathtouch, triggering the second ability granted by Thornbite Staff, untapping your creature.
Repeat until all opponents' creatures die.
Repeat each time a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

1636-3862-4050-4937.notablePrerequisites:
Lumengrid Augur does not have summoning sickness.
You do not control an Army.
1636-3862-4050-4937.description:
Activate Lumengrid Augur by paying {1} and tapping it, causing target opponent to loot.
Orcish Bowmasters triggers, dealing 1 damage to any target, then creating a 0/0 Orc Army creature token and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When the Orc Army enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Orc Army, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

1147-2034-4875.description:
Cast Grovetender Druids by paying {2}{G}{W}.
When Grovetender Druids enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Plant creature token.
When the Plant enters the battlefield as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Grovetender Druids triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Plant, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Grovetender Druids trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Plant creature token.
Repeat from step 3.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Plants.

427-1812-3525.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Kydele.
You have drawn at least three cards this turn.
Kydele does not have summoning sickness.
427-1812-3525.description:
Activate Kydele by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Prismite by paying {2}, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Kydele.
Repeat.

802-2649-3581-4615.manaNeeded: {U}{R}{R}{R} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
802-2649-3581-4615.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional non-Human nonlegendary creature.
You control two lands that can tap to produce at least {1}{W/U}.
802-2649-3581-4615.description:
Activate two lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}{W/U}.
Cast Vadrok either from your hand or from the command zone for its mutate cost by paying {1}{W/U}{R}{R} and commander tax, if applicable, putting it under any other nonlegendary non-Human creature you control.
Vadrok triggers, casting Quasiduplicate from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Kykar triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve Quasiduplicate, creating a copy of the Vadrok mutated creature.
Activate Kykar by sacrificing a Spirit, adding {R}.
Cast Snap by paying {1}{U}.
Kykar triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve Snap, returning the mutated creature that contains the nontoken Vadrok from the battlefield to your hand and untapping two lands that can tap to produce at least {1}{W/U}.
Activate Kykar by sacrificing a Spirit, adding {R}.
Activate two lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}{W/U}.
Cast Vadrok for its mutate cost by paying {1}{W/U}{R}{R}, putting it under the token Vadrok mutated creature.
The nontoken and token Vadrok each trigger.
Resolve the nontoken Vadrok trigger, casting Quasiduplicate from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Kykar triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve Quasiduplicate, creating a copy of the Vadrok mutated creature.
Resolve the token Vadrok trigger from step 13, casting Snap from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Kykar triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve Snap, returning the  mutated creature that contains the nontoken Vadrok from the battlefield to your hand and untapping two lands that can tap to produce at least {1}{W/U}.
Activate Kykar twice by sacrificing two Spirits, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat from step 12.
With each iteration, you will gain an additional Vadrok trigger, which you can use to cast any other noncreature spells with mana value 3 or less in your graveyard, and create infinite Spirit tokens due to Kykar.

1671-1719-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Vizier of Tumbling Sands does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
1671-1719-4222.description:
Activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding {U}{G}.
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands by tapping it, untapping Simic Growth Chamber.
Activate Freed from the Real's last ability by paying {U}, untapping Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
Repeat any number of times.

1687-3161-5256.notablePrerequisites: You control another Human or Solider.
1687-3161-5256.description:
Cast Reins of the Vinesteed by paying {3}{G}, enchanting any Human or Soldier you control besides Siona.
Siona triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature enchanted by Reins of the Vinesteed.
The creature dies, triggering Reins of the Vinesteed, returning Reins of the Vinesteed to the battlefield enchanting the Human Soldier token.
Siona triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat from step 3.

527-1909-2232-4852.notablePrerequisites:
Selvala and Elvish Mystic do not have summoning sickness.
You control a creature with power four or greater.
527-1909-2232-4852.description:
Activate Elvish Mystic by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Wirewood Symbiote by returning Elvish Mystic to your hand, untapping Selvala.
Cast Elvish Mystic by paying {G}.
Elvish Mystic enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning Wirewood Symbiote to your hand.
Cast Wirewood Symbiote by paying {G}.
Wirewood Symbiote enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning nothing to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.
